actions.description: Steps conversational progression from IDLE to INTENT to PLAN to APPROVAL.
Assesses tool response: routes to RESPONSE_SYNTHESIZED on success, or loops back to PLAN_PROPOSED / PARAM_ELICITATION on runtime failure.
Loops back to proposal to select fallback tool after transient execution failure.
Increases scrutiny upon detecting anomalous token entropy or rate acceleration.
Safely steps down scrutiny upon benign token clearance.
Coupled Halting Morphism: Outer violation atomically halts Inner FSM and bounds session in enclave.
Functorial inverse morphism restoring previous safe checkpoint with signed audit witness.
Submits false-positive or ergonomic observations into generational feedback stream.
